packageRules.description: Disable updates for upstream-only Docker images

UBI9 base images: own PR group (separate from the org-wide Docker Images group, so other images cannot block it), automerge once CI passes, and skip the default 3-day release-age wait so fixes ship within 3 working days. rebaseWhen keeps the PR current, which automerge requires.
go-toolset ships the Go compiler. Same-RHEL-minor rebuilds may automerge, but a new RHEL minor (e.g. 9.8 -> 9.9) can bring a newer Go, so it gets its own PR and stays manual.
Never open major-version updates for UBI9 base images; these need a human.
Valid tags for go-toolset, ubi, ubi-minimal and ubi-micro are <RHEL 9 minor>-<build>, e.g. 9.8-1787080706.
httpd-24 is tagged <stream>-<build>, e.g. 1-1793639139; do not let it flip to 9.x-<build> (same digest, only churn).

Security-only Go updates on every branch. main is merged weekly from sigstore/cosign (sync-upstream.yaml), so routine bumps conflict with upstream, and release branches should not take routine bumps (including majors). Security fixes still come through via vulnerabilityAlerts.enabled.
